sources.title: Average Retail Price of Selected Non-Food Items 2025

notes: Average retail prices of 11 non-food items, 2015–2025, B$, as published. Group header rows (blank in this edition) dropped. 'set_price' marks Government-set tariffs and fees (water, electricity, gas, passports), as classified by the author; the table itself doesn't say so. Units as given in the item names; 'unit not stated' where the table gives none.
